notes:
Inbound from marketing automation stack (CTA on blog + demo request). Product: multi-tenant content microservice that generates 50-500 short snippets per user action (subject lines, CTAs, hero text). High QPS during campaign launches; spikes last 10-30 minutes.

Key asks / pain: fast per-request turnaround for UI (<300ms desirable for single-snapshot snippets), but overall cost is primary constraint — they batch monthly billing across tenants and need predictable unit economics. Interested in: automatic KV/prefix caching, server-side batching for bulk jobs, model recommendations for cost/quality tradeoffs, and per-route token accounting.

Quote from CEO (paraphrase): "We need a hostable API we can scale without blowing up monthly costs — small model with smart caching might do it."

Technical notes: using Node.js serverless edge for front-facing calls; backend worker queues for bulk generation. Current PoC needs: sample batch endpoint, SDK snippet for prefetch + cache keys, guidance on quantized model variants. They ran quick benchmark vs OpenAI gpt-4-lite (cost too high) and Cohere (similar pricing) and want Redwood to show unit cost reduction path.

Security/compliance: SOC2 nice-to-have, require audit logs + 30-day retention by default. No on-prem/VPC yet — public cloud only.

Commercial: SMB pricing sensitivity. Estimated ARR ask: $5k-25k/year if unit economics match. AE note: prioritize low-touch onboarding; stopgap = clear self-serve docs + starter templates.

Open questions: exact token pricing tiers for sustained QPS, burst capacity behavior, SLA for hosted plan, sample billing breakdown per-tenant.
